title: HABIT: Human Action Benchmark for Interactive Traffic in CARLA
summary: HABIT retargets real mocap and video human motion into CARLA and curates 4,730 traffic-compatible SMPL motions to expose perception, prediction, and planning failures hidden by deterministic pedestrian scripts.

mechanisms.name: Real-motion-retargeted CARLA pedestrians
mechanisms.description: Replace simple scripted pedestrian trajectories with physically consistent, diverse human motions retargeted from real mocap and video while holding the CARLA scene and agent evaluation contract fixed.
mechanisms.limitations: Automotive planning failures under retargeted pedestrians do not establish wearable sensing, BlindAssist event correctness, natural-world frequency, Android runtime, BLV user benefit, product readiness, or safety.

aliases: Human Action Benchmark for Interactive Traffic
